Lighting modes: explicitly teleported scene inspection, frozen living actors, deterministic process advances, not a native journey. Lighting-perf measures only named isolated windows; global timing includes setup and is not comparative. Persistence controlled cameras do not count as movement. Native save/load is bounded by new Player/World IDs.
